verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth has its own programmatic surface: an OpenAPI spec responds at supabase.com/openapi.json, each project exposes a JWKS URL, the client library takes tokens via an `accessToken` option, and there is a JavaScript auth-api reference page. However, the evidence does not show that the OpenAPI spec covers Auth endpoints, and no quoted docs enumerate Auth REST operations. Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages) support agent use. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Auth REST endpoints (sign-up, sign-in, admin/user management), confirmation that the OpenAPI spec covers Auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Auth via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Supabase Auth exposes a [JSON Web Key](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7517) Set URL for each Supabase project:
you can pass it to the client library using the `accessToken` option.
